candidateAudit.title: if you’re looking for a proper italian restaurant in vienna, gondola is definitely one to know. gondola.vienna the whole place feels warm, authentic and really welcoming, with such
candidateAudit.text: if you’re looking for a proper italian restaurant in vienna, gondola is definitely one to know. gondola.vienna the whole place feels warm, authentic and really welcoming, with such a lovely owner and team behind it. we started with spaghetti bolognese, and honestly, i always think a really good ragù says a lot about an italian kitchen. this one was easily my favourite dish of the evening. gondola also has its own pasta manufactory, which makes the whole pasta side of the menu even more interesting. after that we shared the gondola speciale pizza with pomodorini, buffalo mozzarella, walnuts, truffle cream and basil, and finished with pistachio tiramisu and a surprisingly great coffee. a really lovely italian spot in 1050 that feels like somewhere you can actually stay for the whole evening. ad / invited #ceschlist #ristorantegondola #viennafood #viennarestaurants #viennaeats #1050wien #italianfoodvienna #viennaguide
